result:
Comments, deletion, reporting and hiding are implemented, and `bunx guren gate` passes (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, and `bun test` with 22 tests). Nothing is committed.

Things you might not expect:

- **Whitespace is trimmed from comment bodies**, matching how post fields are validated, so a blank-only body is rejected and the 2000-character limit applies after trimming.
- **Report is only shown to signed-in viewers** on the post page; guests see a "Sign in to leave a comment" link instead.
- **I rebuilt the local test database** (`data/guren.test.db`) with `db:reset`, because it had applied a first draft of the migration that I then regenerated. The dev database was not touched and still has the new migration pending — run `bun run db:migrate` before using the app locally.
- **`created_at` on both new tables has a SQL default**, so rows inserted by review tooling or raw SQL get a timestamp without supplying one.
- **I added an ADR** (`docs/adr/0002-hide-comments-at-three-distinct-reports.md`, status `draft`) recording the three-report rule; it wasn't asked for.

**Summary of changes:** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports` (unique on `comment_id`, `user_id`; cascade on delete), with the migration in `db/migrations/20260929151714_add_comments/`. New `app/Models/Comment.ts` holds the threshold of three and `Comment.visibleOn()`, which derives hiding from the report rows at read time. `app/Models/CommentReport.ts` has the idempotent `record()`, and `app/Models/Post.ts` gains a `comments` relation. New `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts` (`store`, `destroy`, `report`) is backed by `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts` and `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts`, registered in `app/Providers/AuthorizationProvider.ts`. `routes/web.ts` adds `posts.comments.store`, `comments.destroy` and `comments.report` behind the existing `auth` middleware. `PostController.show` now passes `comments`, and `PostController.destroy` removes a post's comments and their reports in a transaction. The post page (`resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`) renders the new `resources/js/components/PostComments.tsx`. Feature tests are in `tests/CommentController.test.ts`, and the `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests were regenerated.
